questions.text: What small quality do you always appreciate in a friend?
When did you last feel proud of yourself?
If the whole group went on a trip, where would you want to go?
What skill would you like to learn with a friend?
What piece of advice helped you change?
What would you like the group to do together this year?
Thank someone in the group directly.
Advertise a nearby object for 20 seconds.
Act out a movie scene using facial expressions and let the group guess.
Give everyone in the group a positive nickname.
Write a two-line poem about today's gathering.
Invite a willing volunteer to create a 10-second dance with you.
